faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Manager position at IIT Hyderabad?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Manager post at IIT Hyderabad is 23 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Manager role?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a BTech/BE/MTech/ME degree along with an MBA in HR/Social Sciences/Rural Development or related fields. Relevant experience is also a key requirement.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Manager position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Manager position is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Manager post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary ranging from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 80,000 per month, with a potential bonus of up to Rs. 50,000 based on annual output.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Project Manager post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Project Manager position at IIT Hyderabad through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for the Project Manager position at IIT Hyderabad is strictly online. Candidates must apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Manager role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Manager position will primarily involve an interview. Shortlisted candidates will be informed via email.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this? Contract or Permanent?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job. The recruitment is for a Project Manager position on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the online application link in the "Important Links" section of this article. The official website of IIT Hyderabad is also provided there.
